scope: Paired development comparison of seven configured selection procedures; not an adoption study
tree: one balanced tree, height one; ten disjoint 6-7-tip clades selected randomly
simulation: independent Gaussian branch recursion, no inference-package simulator

selection.nwkit: bootstrap B19 level .05, pBIC, AIC or BIC; shared heuristic pool24/refit48/screen2000/beam2; cap10
selection.kfl1ou: corrected pBIC, ordinary AIC or BIC; default candidate search; cap10

covariance_fit: alpha and process variance estimated independently by each method; each method retains its existing bounds/optimizer
order: sequential; cyclic method-order rotation across datasets
wall_scope: process startup + input + inference + JSON, no plots or support bootstrap
memory: Linux wait4 ru_maxrss in MiB; single-worker process high-water RSS, not host or VM memory
failure_policy: retain every failure/timeout; do not treat uncalibrated candidate as a completed selection; report conditional accuracy separately
native_auxiliary: record initial search and uncalibrated maximum-likelihood candidate as diagnostics only
baseline_requirement: Corrected pBIC capability attestation must pass before timing
